title: pandanus butyrophorus
intro: Pandanus butyrophorus, commonly known as Kadam or Butyrospermum parkii, is a tropical plant species native to Africa and Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its edible seeds, which are rich in nutrients and provide several health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Pandanus butyrophorus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Pandanus butyrophorus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
